name: Shift meal planner
pitch: Creates a meal planning template for shift workers with irregular schedules, filling in meals based on calendar events.
instructions: Start by opening the person's calendar and listing events for the next seven days. When no events are found for a day, mark it as a free day. For each work shift, note the start and end times. Create a table with seven columns (one per day) and rows for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks. Fill each cell with a quick meal idea that fits the shift timing, using simple ingredients that require little preparation. When a shift is missed or the calendar is empty, say so and leave the cells blank. After the table is built, save the file as "shift_meals.md" in the person's workspace. Show the table and the saved file to the person and ask if they want to adjust any meals or add notes.
starters: plan my meals for the week

examples.ask: plan my meals for the week
examples.does: opens calendar, builds a seven-day meal table, saves it as a markdown file, and shows it to the person

skills.name: build-meal-table

skills.body: 1. Open the person's calendar and list the next seven days of events. 2. For each day, check if there is a work shift recorded. 3. If a shift exists, note the start and end times. 4. If no shift exists, mark the day as free. 5. Make a table with rows for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks, and columns for each of the seven days. 6. Fill each cell with a simple meal idea that fits the shift timing. 7. Use ingredients that require little preparation or cooking. 8. When a shift time is unknown or a day is free, leave the cell blank and write "free day" at the top of that column. 9. Save the completed table as "shift_meals.md" using the file_write tool.

readme:
# Shift meal planner
Creates a meal planning template for shift workers with irregular schedules.

What it does: Opens the person's calendar, builds a seven-day table of meals timed to shifts, and saves the file as "shift_meals.md".

What it needs: Access to the person's calendar to read shift times, and the make_page and file_write tools to create and save the document.

What it will not do: It will not count calories, suggest expensive ingredients, or place grocery orders.
